$why: THE ROSTER IN TURNS — one agent's entry per turn, on a set that cuts long answers. See
description: Appended to the roster specialiser's prompt on a budgeted set: answer with one named agent's entry.
body:
## THIS TURN: ONE AGENT ONLY — __AGENT__
Your answers on this platform are limited to about __BUDGET_CHARS__ characters, so the roster is built one agent per turn. In THIS turn answer with the JSON object described above containing ONLY the entry for "__AGENT__" — {"agents": {"__AGENT__": { ... }}} — and keep the whole answer within that limit.
